violations.title: Cooling from Ambient to 41F, No More than 4 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item prepared from ambient air temperature ingredients is not being adequately cooled to 41F or less within 4 hours: BLACK BEAN EGG CHEESE QUESADILLA (46-51F) WAS STORED IN EATS 2 GO COOLER OVERNIGHT.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 41F or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient air temperature (i.e. reconstituted foods and canned tuna). CFM DISCARDED THE FOOD ITEMS.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at @LOCATION@ is equipped with separate cold and hot water faucets rather than a mixing valve or combination faucet. HOT WATER TEMPERATURE AT HAND SINK WAS 94F DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. THE FACILITY ORDERED A TANKLESS WATER HEATER AND A THERMOSTATIC MIXING VALVE IMMEDIATELY.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: (1) BUFFALO CHICKEN WRAP (43F), SMOKE HAM CHEDDAR SANDWICH (43F), CREAM CHEESE SPREAD (43F) WERE STORED IN 1-DOOR UNDER COUNTER COOLER (OVEN) OVERNIGHT. (2) HALF-HALF (44F) WAS STORED IN 1-DOOR UNDER COUNTER COOLER (ESPRESSO) FOR MORE THAN 4 HOURS.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM DISCARDED THE FOOD ITEMS.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. CFM PROMPTED THE FOOD EMPLOYEES TO PUT ON HAIR RESTRAINTS.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 1-DOOR UNDER COUNTER COOLER (OVEN).
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. ENGINEER ADJUSTED THE TEMPERATURE OF THE UNIT. FINAL AMBIENT TEMPERATURE WAS 36F.
